Corollary
[Kähler–Ricci scalar and determinant estimates] Source: cao-zhu 1. Corollary 2.5.10\group Cao–Zhu Li-Yau-Hamilton Estimates Under the assumptions of Theorem $2.5.9,$ we have

  • the scalar curvature $R$ satisfies the estimate

    \[ rac{\partial R}{\partial t}- rac{| abla R|^2}{R} + rac{R}{t}\geq 0, \]

    and

  • assuming $R_{\alpha ar eta }>0$, the determinant $\phi =\det (R_{\alpha ar eta })/\det (g_{\alpha ar eta })$ of the Ricci curvature satisfies the estimate

    \[ rac{\partial \phi }{\partial t}- rac{| abla \phi |^2}{n\phi } + rac{n\phi }{t}\geq 0 \]

    for all $x\in M$ and $t>0$.
